description: Check the 285 vs 309 residue start-codon discrepancy and plot robustness/confidence of the structural call
code:
exec(open("aln.py").read())
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
q="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P43617.fasta",timeout=30).text.split("\n")[1:])
orth={}
for a in ["J8PP08","J8TXW4","H0GFS1","A0A6C1DQS1"]:
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text
    if t.startswith(">"): orth[a]="".join(t.split("\n")[1:])
print("S288C P43617 length",len(q),"| residue 25 =",q[24],"| N-term 1-30:",q[:30])
for a,s in orth.items():
    r=align(q,s,GAP=10,free_ends=False)
    lead=len(r["a2"])-len(r["a2"].lstrip("-"))
    print(f"{a}: len={len(s)} pid={r['pid']:.1f}%  N-term of ortholog: {s[:20]}  | alignment starts with {r['a1'][:28]} / {r['a2'][:28]}")
print("\nConclusion check: do the 285-aa orthologs begin at the residue aligned to S288C Met25?")
a=list(orth)[0]; r=align(q,orth[a],GAP=10,free_ends=False)
print(r["a1"][:40]); print(r["a2"][:40])

# figure: robustness + confidence of the structural call
R=pd.read_csv("plus8_robustness.tsv",sep="\t")
rob={"MRX20":27,"CTP1":27,"YHM2":27,"hSLC25A1":18,"SFC1":18,"DIC1":27,"hSLC25A10":18,"hSLC25A11":18,"OAC1":18,
     "ODC1":27,"ODC2":27,"hSLC25A21":27,"GGC1":27,"MIR1":12,"ORT1":18,"CRC1":9,"PET8":18}
plddt={"MRX20":89,"CTP1":89,"YHM2":78,"hSLC25A1":80,"SFC1":84,"DIC1":85,"hSLC25A10":83,"hSLC25A11":90,"OAC1":90,
       "ODC1":97,"ODC2":93,"hSLC25A21":91,"GGC1":95,"MIR1":94,"ORT1":82,"CRC1":90,"PET8":92}
R["robust"]=R.carrier.map(rob); R["plddt_p8"]=R.carrier.map(plddt)
cmap={"tricarboxylate":"#b03a2e","dicarboxylate":"#d68910","oxodicarboxylate":"#7d6608","nucleotide":"#1f618d",
      "phosphate":"#2e86c1","cationic aa":"#148f77","acylcarnitine":"#117a65","SAM":"#6c3483","unknown":"#000000"}
R=R.sort_values(["class","carrier"])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,5.2))
ax=axes[0]; y=np.arange(len(R))
ax.barh(y,R.robust,color=[cmap[c] for c in R["class"]],
        edgecolor=["black" if c=="MRX20" else "none" for c in R.carrier],lw=1.6)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(R.carrier,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(27,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("parameter sets (of 27) in which the contact point II anchor is selected")
ax.set_title("Cavity scan is insensitive to its window parameters",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
ax.barh(y,R.plddt_p8,color=[cmap[c] for c in R["class"]],
        edgecolor=["black" if c=="MRX20" else "none" for c in R.carrier],lw=1.6)
for yi,(_,r_) in enumerate(R.iterrows()):
    ax.text(r_.plddt_p8+1,yi,r_.plus8,va="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold" if r_.carrier=="MRX20" else "normal")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([]); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(0,105)
ax.axvline(70,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("AlphaFold pLDDT at the +8 residue (letter = residue)")
ax.set_title("Residue at contact point II +8: Arg only in citrate carriers",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
R.to_csv("plus8_robustness.tsv",sep="\t",index=False)
